findings.evidence: User endpoint passes principal.userId() into addUserTicketMessage, but that method immediately delegates to addTicketMessage; addTicketMessage inserts by ticket_id only and returns adminTicket(id), so a normal user can append to and receive details for any ticket id if they know it. There is no WHERE user_id=? ownership check in the write path.
findings.issue: User support-ticket message write bypasses ticket ownership and leaks cross-user ticket details.
findings.requirement_ref: ACTIVE_TASK acceptance: 权限/幂等/错误码/审计覆盖; risks: security

findings.evidence: DecideRequest/AssignRequest/CloseRequest require expectedVersion, but content-report decide updates with WHERE id=? only, support assign updates with WHERE id=? only, and support close updates with WHERE id=? AND status='RESOLVED' only. These writes neither compare expectedVersion nor increment a version, allowing stale admin decisions/assignments/closes to overwrite current state.
findings.issue: Required optimistic-concurrency contract is ignored on admin write operations.
findings.requirement_ref: ACTIVE_TASK acceptance: 权限/幂等/错误码/审计覆盖

findings.evidence: ACTIVE_TASK requires implementing 25 operationIds and OpenAPI contract tests, but the added R15_OPERATION_IDS set contains only 23 strings and the test checks Java source text rather than OpenAPI contract behavior. This can pass while the declared 25-operation contract remains incomplete or mismatched.
findings.issue: Added test weakens the contract gate by hardcoding an incomplete 23-operation source-text check instead of validating the required 25 OpenAPI operations.
findings.requirement_ref: ACTIVE_TASK objective/deliverables: 实现范围内25个operationId; OpenAPI契约测试
